title: iPhone Duo shipping estimates have already been pushed back to 2027

claims.claim: Apple described the early demand for the iPhone Duo as nothing short of extraordinary in a statement to CNBC.

evidence.quote: After preorders for Apple's first foldable phone went live on Friday, the company characterized the demand as "nothing short of extraordinary" in a statement to CNBC.
Apple called the early demand “nothing short of extraordinary.”

claims.claim: Preorders for Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, went live on Friday.

evidence.quote: After preorders for Apple's first foldable phone went live on Friday, the company characterized the demand as "nothing short of extraordinary" in a statement to CNBC.

claims.claim: Shipping estimates for iPhone Duo preorders in the US have been pushed back as late as January 2027.

evidence.quote: So far, shipping estimates for the latest iPhone Duo preorders in the US have been pushed back as late as January 2027.

claims.claim: Some online customers are able to pick up their iPhone Duo orders at an Apple Store as early as October 23.

evidence.quote: Anecdotal evidence from online customers are showing everything from being able to pick up their iPhone Duo orders at an Apple Store as early as October 23 to others receiving shipping estimates for November and December.

claims.claim: Some customers are receiving shipping estimates for the iPhone Duo for November and December.

evidence.quote: Anecdotal evidence from online customers are showing everything from being able to pick up their iPhone Duo orders at an Apple Store as early as October 23 to others receiving shipping estimates for November and December.

claims.claim: The online Apple Store shows delivery windows for January for those who missed the earliest waves of preorders, along with a pickup option to check back for availability on 10.24.

evidence.quote: Those who missed the boat on the earliest waves of preorders are seeing delivery windows for January on the online Apple Store, but also a pickup option that says to "Check back for availability on 10.24."

claims.claim: Best Buy's website is currently showing iPhone Duo shipping estimates for November as of the time of the article's publishing.

evidence.quote: As for third-party options, Best Buy's website is currently showing iPhone Duo shipping estimates for November as of the time of the article's publishing.
